This year marks the first time that the two wineries have split the vineyard's fruit. Layne Montgomery believes that the Century Block's fruit produces an exceptional wine, and he and Ryan Sherman of Fields Family Wines have decided to work together to create a "Century Project" bottling that will celebrate the vineyard's heritage.
